@application @toolbar
Feature: Quick access toolbar customization
  The MCAD Software provides a customizable toolbar for frequently used commands.

  Scenario: Add and remove a quick access command
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
    And Print is not present on the toolbar
    And New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are present on the toolbar
    When the user opens the quick access customization menu
    Then Print is unchecked
    And New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo and Home are checked
    When the user selects Print
    Then a Print icon appears on the quick access toolbar
    When the user reopens the customization menu
    Then Print is checked
    When the user selects Print again
    Then the Print icon is removed from the toolbar
    And the same part remains active

  Scenario: Move the quick access toolbar below and above the ribbon
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
    And Print is visible on the toolbar
    When the user opens the quick access customization menu
    And the user chooses Show Below the Ribbon
    Then the quick access toolbar appears in a row below the ribbon
    And Print remains visible on the toolbar
    When the user reopens the customization menu
    Then Print is checked
    And Show Above the Ribbon is offered
    When the user chooses Show Above the Ribbon
    Then the quick access toolbar returns above the ribbon
    And the same part remains active

  Scenario: Add and remove a ribbon command through its context menu
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And Extrude is available on the 3D Model ribbon
    And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar
    When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon
    Then its context menu offers Add to Quick Access Toolbar
    When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar
    Then an Extrude icon appears on the quick access toolbar
    And Extrude remains available on the ribbon
    When the user right-clicks the added quick access icon
    Then its context menu offers Remove from Quick Access Toolbar
    When the user chooses Remove from Quick Access Toolbar
    Then the added icon disappears from the quick access toolbar
    And Extrude remains available on the ribbon
    And the same part remains active

  Scenario: Add a separator from a toolbar command context menu
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar
    When the user right-clicks its quick access icon
    Then the context menu offers Add Separator
    When the user chooses Add Separator
    Then the quick access row gains a narrow divider beside the added command
    And the same part remains active

  Scenario: Invoke an added command from quick access in an empty part
    Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
    And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar
    And the 3D Model ribbon is active
    When the user selects the Extrude quick access icon
    Then the workspace displays the origin planes for selection
    And Start 2D Sketch is highlighted on the ribbon
    When the user presses Escape
    Then the origin plane selection display closes
    And the empty part remains active

  Scenario: Invoke an added shortcut while another ribbon tab is active
    Given an empty part is active in the MCAD Software
    And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from 3D Model
    When the user selects the View ribbon tab
    Then the Extrude quick access icon remains visible
    When the user selects the Extrude quick access icon
    Then the origin planes are displayed for selection
    And the View ribbon remains displayed
    When the user presses Escape
    Then the origin plane selection display closes
    And the empty part remains active

  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Show a part shortcut in part documents but not an assembly
    Given two parts and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software
    And the first part is active
    And Extrude has been added to the quick access toolbar from its ribbon
    When the user activates the assembly document
    Then the Extrude shortcut is not shown on its quick access toolbar
    When the user reactivates the first part
    Then the Extrude shortcut is visible again
    When the user activates the second part
    Then the Extrude shortcut is visible there as well
    And the second part remains active

  Scenario: Disable the add option for an existing shortcut
    Given a part is active in the MCAD Software
    And Extrude is not on the quick access toolbar
    When the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon
    Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled
    When the user chooses Add to Quick Access Toolbar
    And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again
    Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is disabled
    When the user dismisses the menu and remove the Extrude quick access icon
    And the user right-clicks Extrude on the ribbon again
    Then Add to Quick Access Toolbar is enabled


  @needs_fixture
  Scenario: Keep a standard shortcut selection when switching document contexts
    Given a part and an assembly are open in the MCAD Software
    And Print is not selected in either document's quick access customization menu
    When the user activates the part and selects Print in its quick access customization menu
    Then Print appears on the part's quick access toolbar
    When the user activates the assembly
    Then Print is absent from the assembly's quick access toolbar
    When the user opens its quick access customization menu
    Then Print is unchecked
    When the user returns to the part
    Then Print is visible on the part's quick access toolbar
    When the user opens its quick access customization menu
    Then Print is checked
    When the user selects Print again
    Then Print is removed from the part's quick access toolbar

  Scenario: Show Redo disabled when no redo action is available
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And Redo is present on the quick access toolbar
    And no redo action is available in the active document
    When the user inspects the quick access toolbar
    Then Redo remains visible but disabled
    And the active part remains open

  Scenario: Inspect and dismisses quick access command choices
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And the full Tools ribbon is selected
    And the quick access toolbar is above the ribbon
    When the user opens the quick access toolbar customization menu
    Then the menu lists New, Open, Save, Undo, Redo, Home, Projects, Update, Select, Refine Appearance, Material Browser, Materials, Appearance Browser, Appearance Override, Adjust, Clear, Parameters, Design Doctor, Print, iProperties, Return, and Measure
    And each listed command displays its current checked or unchecked state
    And the menu offers Show Below the Ribbon
    When the user presses Escape
    Then the customization menu closes
    And the command check states remain unchanged
    And the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible

  Scenario: Open and close the Material Browser from quick access
    Given a part document is active in the MCAD Software
    And the Tools ribbon is selected
    And the Material Browser quick access command is visible
    And the Material Browser window is closed
    When the user selects the Material Browser quick access command
    Then the Material Browser window opens over the part workspace
    And the part remains active
    When the user closes the Material Browser window
    Then the browser window closes
    And the Tools ribbon and active part remain visible
